integrity: Symbolic valuation proof covers infinitely many ranks; exact integer program and finite CSV certificates cover stated rank-three and rank-four enumerations. No floating-point or unsupported extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: The complete singular-character classification is proved only for matrix size three; the zero-free all-dimensional family and ranks four and five do not classify all other dimensions. The integer rook-transform formula is classical machinery; novelty attaches to the specific valuation family and rank-three Fourier transition, not to rook-polynomial techniques. The novelty comparison is bounded and independent audit has not been performed.
title: Ternary Fourier rigidity and a rank-three resonance for signed permutation matrices
